whatIs.title: What are QR Codes?
whatIs.description: Quick Response (QR) codes are two-dimensional barcodes that store data in a matrix of black and white squares. They can store URLs, contact info, WiFi credentials, and more. SafeTools generates these codes locally using <link>WASM engines</link> to ensure your data never touches a server.

privacy.title: Privacy Architecture
items: Zero server storage of your QR data
No tracking pixels or analytics redirects
Local-first generation in your browser RAM

security.title: Security Warning
security.description: QR codes can be used for phishing if they point to malicious URLs. Always verify the destination of a QR code before scanning. SafeTools provides a clean, local-first environment for generating trusted codes.
security.footer: Explore our <vault>File Vault</vault> or <notes>Secure Notes</notes> for more protection.

correction.title: Error Correction Levels
correction.description: Error correction allows a QR code to remain scannable even if it is partially damaged or obscured. Higher levels allow for more damage but increase the code's complexity.

static.title: Static vs. Dynamic QR
static.description: SafeTools generates static QR codes, which are generally safer for privacy-conscious users.
static.static: Static: Data is hardcoded directly into the QR pattern.
static.dynamic: Dynamic: Points to a URL redirect, allowing for tracking and analytics.

items.q: Are my QR codes saved on your servers?
items.a: No. All QR codes are generated locally on your device. We don't store or see the data you input.

items.q: Can I add my company logo to the QR code?
items.a: Yes! You can upload a logo to be placed in the center of the QR code. This is also processed locally.

items.q: What is the best error correction level to use?
items.a: Level H (High) is recommended if you're adding a logo, as it provides the most resilience against data loss.
